scenario: Identical generated BGRA fixtures; four frames per scenario, four warmups followed by twenty measured frames, two passes with reversed codec order. 1024x768, twelve 1024x64 rectangles per frame.

codecs.zrle: RFB 16, current tile/palette implementation, system zlib level 1, persistent stream

validation: Independent Python RFC 6143 tile decoder plus persistent zlib inflation; every source pixel compared. Raw/solid/packed/plain-RLE/palette-RLE reference vectors also passed.
limitations: Encoder wall/thread CPU only; excludes capture, dirty detection, network and actual Screen Sharing decode.
Malformed ZRLE output invalidates bandwidth and latency comparisons on palette-runs, many-colors and document scenarios.
Synthetic fixtures on one VM; not general codec ratios or production-client FPS.
